page.content:
Edenian princess raised as Shao Kahn's assassin daughter.

How Kitana connects

  • Location: Outworld — Kitana was raised as Shao Kahn's Outworld assassin-daughter.
  • Character: Shao Kahn — Kitana turned on Shao Kahn after learning he stole Edenia.
  • Character: Mileena — Mileena was cloned to replace Kitana as a loyal sister-heir.

What is Kitana?

Kitana is the fan-wielding princess of Edenia, raised in Outworld as Shao Kahn's daughter until she learned her real father was the king Kahn overthrew.

Key threads lead to Outworld, Shao Kahn and Mileena.
